B1.t: No notifications exist: every reminder control is a no-op

B2.t: Crisis help is a placeholder page with no way in

B3.t: Default sign-up sets the guessable password magic-<email>; no passwordless sign-in or password reset

B4.t: A store build silently falls back to the offline mock (local plaintext accounts, no cloud data, free purchases)

B5.t: No account deletion, data export, Terms or Privacy links; paywall lacks auto-renew disclosure

B6.t: App ships as 'tideline' with the Expo template icon

B7.t: Hard-coded and fallback prices (Yearly Drop $26.99 / Save 74% / 'billed once'; paywall canned prices; invented renewal dates)

B8.t: About 3.4 GB of design captures tracked in git, no .easignore: the EAS upload exceeds its limit

B10.t: Offline: cold start never leaves the splash (SOS unreachable), and every Done that awaits a write hangs

B11.t: No error boundary or crash reporting

B12.t: Unauthenticated Convex mutations can overwrite the lessons table; the client can set premium

B13.t: App lock and 'Hide sensitive previews' are decorative

B14.t: Privacy screen promises the code does not keep (encryption, 'Pause analytics')

L1.t: 'Day N' is 24-hour blocks from the sign-up moment, not calendar days; DST shifts yesterday/tomorrow

L2.t: The programme clock starts at account creation, not at Day 0

L3.t: Lesson state comes from the day number only; completion is never read back, and future lessons can be 'finished' for points

L5.t: Today and Library freeze 'now' at mount; overnight they show and write yesterday

L6.t: Rows for days without a check-in are created and counted as check-ins

L7.t: A night check-in after midnight files the wrong date

L8.t: Morning, night and the old check-in share one mood field on different scales

L9.t: The launch gate reopens the check-in on every cold launch; the night check-in has no other door

L10.t: 'Tonight's action' is filed as tomorrow's task (a two-day lag); morning re-asks a ticked task

L11.t: Lesson answers and notes are saved but never shown, though 32 lessons say they are in the log

S1.t: The recovery score reads as arbitrary: points for time passing, no floor, ranks end mid-course, unscaled chart, a 'streak' that is days since sign-up, three different daily deltas

S2.t: Starting Score shows '1,000 of 1,000' for everyone after a fake 6.8 s loader, then the score passes its own maximum

S3.t: Two ways to log a slip with different effects on score, streak, medallions and reports

S4.t: Counts include days before the account existed

S5.t: Lessons medallion tops out at 110 on an 84-lesson course; Rebound tiers reward more slips

S6.t: Medallion post encloses 'Vici, Tier I' that the album says is not earned

P1.t: Onboarding cost, projection and plan boards show the designer's sample numbers and answers

P2.t: Questionnaire answers are thrown away; a machine-assembled 'reason' is quoted back in the slip letter

P3.t: Sample identity shown as the user's: 'Sam', the sample pledge, an invented signed vow and dates

P4.t: SOS and slip boards show sample copy and assumptions ('This one is intense.', 'Get out of bed.', 'Waited out the timer', credited changes)

P5.t: Medallion and letter copy invents statistics and claims; letters identical for everyone; quote misattributions

P6.t: Purchase and trial copy that is not true for the user (trial to the ineligible, emailed receipt, restored = 'yearly', two tier names)

P7.t: Profile: photo actions do nothing; '@username' invented from the email

P8.t: Consent: marketing opt-in pre-ticked and never stored; age gate pre-answered '24'

F1.t: Urge hub records nothing; its chips and timer do nothing

F2.t: Swipe-back / Android back exits the whole SOS or slip flow

F3.t: Unrated intensity is stored as 'Intense'; the urge log pre-selects 'Rode it out'

F4.t: SOS answers are never read back; closing SOS logs nothing; 'Done' on non-final boards; sound setting inert; half-built resume

F5.t: Slip flow's 'Sign it again' stores nothing

U1.t: Built features with no door in production (Support, Rough days, Life Map, Insights, Mail, Back Tap, Journal, First steps, Journey, Locked)

U2.t: Dev routes (/all, /kit-lab) and the router's 404/Sitemap reachable by deep link; old 'Finding the waterline…' line

U3.t: Old UI kit, unused native packages and dead modules still bundled

U4.t: Back on the first onboarding question sends a signed-in user to a Login that cannot work

D1.t: Per-device state is not per account: leaks between accounts, lost on reinstall

D2.t: Onboarding lives in memory (no resume, paid users see the paywall again); double-taps duplicate letters and check-ins

D3.t: Journal entries cannot be deleted; 'Past pledges' lists every entry

D4.t: Life Map spins forever on Convex when the account has no row

D5.t: RevenueCat identity: anonymous before logIn, a failed logIn is never retried

R1.t: Weekly reports: DST shifts weeks to Sundays, a first report can cover one day, 'Every Sunday' is not how delivery works

R2.t: Labels that promise what doesn't happen ('Your letter · Opens Week XII')

R3.t: Small display bugs: Urge overview 'Nothing logged' under charted urges; 'Good morning.' until 18:30
